# Aperture editor basics: panels, layers, undo, export, shortcuts

- Kind: `editor`
- Category: `photo`
- Slug: `photo/editor-basics`

## Summary

How Aperture is organised: panels, the layer stack, history and export.

## Details

Panels: presets (Presets), basic (Basic), detail (Detail), geometry (Geometry), masks (Masks), heal (Heal), redEye (Red-eye), curves (Curves), levels (Levels), hsl (Color (HSL)), colorBalance (Color balance), blackWhite (Black & white), channelMixer (Channel mixer), photoFilter (Photo filter), splitTone (Split toning), lut (LUT), effects (Effects), plus Layers and History.
Blend modes for a layer: normal, luminosity, color. Layers can be reordered, hidden, duplicated, renamed and faded with opacity.
Every change is one undo step (Mod+Z / Shift+Mod+Z). Hold \ to see the original. Exports are rendered from the original at full resolution on the server (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF) and count as one everyday job; the preview is drawn in the browser with WebGL2.
Tool pages that open the editor on a panel: aperture → basic; brighten-image → basic; adjust-image-contrast → basic; fix-photo-exposure → basic; adjust-image-hue → hsl; change-image-color → hsl; color-pop → hsl + color-pop-red; image-saturation → basic; photo-levels → levels; photo-curves → curves; white-balance-photo → basic; black-and-white-photo → blackWhite + bw-film; tint-photo → photoFilter; color-balance-photo → colorBalance; split-toning → splitTone; apply-lut-to-photo → lut; invert-image-colors → effects; posterize-image → effects; reduce-image-noise → detail; add-vignette → detail; sharpen-photo-online → detail; straighten-photo → geometry; fix-perspective-photo → geometry; remove-blemishes → heal; select-by-color → masks.
### Shortcuts
- Mod+Z: Undo
- Shift+Mod+Z or Mod+Y: Redo
- Mod+S: Save
- Mod+E: Export
- ?: Show shortcuts
- Mod+J: Open Medi
- \: Hold to see the original
- 0: Fit to screen
- 1: Zoom to 100%
- +: Zoom in
- -: Zoom out
- M: Cycle the mask view
- B: Brush
- E: Toggle erase
- [: Smaller brush
- ]: Larger brush
- G: Gradient mask
- R: Radial mask
- C: Crop
- H: Heal
